description: The chart illustrates the distribution of tasks across various language families, with the horizontal axis representing the number of tasks and the vertical axis listing the language families. The vertical axis is labeled with ten language families, listed in descending order of the number of tasks, and includes IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque. The horizontal axis is labeled "# tasks" and ranges from 0 to 80 in increments of 10. Each language family is represented by a bar of a distinct color, with the length of the bar corresponding to the number of tasks; the bars range in length from approximately 3 for Basque to 78 for IE-Slavic, with notable values including 49 for IE-Romance, 46 for IE-Germanic, and 20 for Uralic. The bars are sorted in descending order of length, with the longest bar at the top and the shortest at the bottom, and there is no apparent visual emphasis on any particular bar.
